newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums ease, gas oil keeps prices steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums ease, gas oil keeps prices steady.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices were slightly softer on Tuesday with barges trade into Rotterdam pegging premiums around $1 lower, traders said.
They said tighter supplies of gas oil in the ARA region were supportive and firmer benchmark IPE gas oil futures had countered the weaker premiums leaving outright prices stable.
Barge differentials were assessed around July IPE +$15 fob ARA after prompt barge trade at that level on Tuesday.
Cargoes were thinly talked around July IPE +$15/$16 cif NWE also around $1 per tonne weaker.
At 1156 GMT benchmark July IPE gas oil futures were trading around $1.25 a tonne firmer at $162.50.
